title: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】Ongoing efforts aim to integrate our understanding of HNSCC biology and immunobiology to identify predictive biomarkers that will enable delivery of the most effective, least-toxic therapies.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Despite evidence of histological progression from cellular atypia through various degrees of dysplasia, ultimately leading to invasive HNSCC, most patients are diagnosed with late-stage HNSCC without a clinically evident antecedent pre-malignant lesion.
